name: Fatima Meer
shortBio: South African sociologist, anti-apartheid theorist, and founding voice of Black women’s civic resistance who analyzed racialized apartheid stratification and cross-community solidarity.
centralQuestion: How do racialized legal hierarchies fragment oppressed communities, and how can empirical sociology serve anti-apartheid liberation?

keyWorks.title: Portrait of Indian South Africans
keyWorks.description: Sociological study documenting South African Indian political consciousness and resistance to apartheid segregation.

keyWorks.title: Higher Than Hope
keyWorks.description: Authorized intellectual biography of Nelson Mandela situating anti-apartheid struggle in ethical and historical context.
